big_case.notes: Constitutional challenge to the federal judiciary's internal EDR process for its own employees' harassment claims: real institutional sensitivity (whole Fourth Circuit recused, out-of-circuit panel, amici), but a single-plaintiff, post-bench-trial record on a superseded 2013 plan with no circuit conflict, ending in an unexplained denial with no noted dissent. Moderate stakes, limited doctrinal reach.
